## Astraeus 2.5.1

### New
- **Timers of any length.** On the Tools page, type a time and press Enter: `20` for minutes, `1h 30m`, `90s` or `1:30`, up to 24 hours.

### Better
- **A more minimal Settings.** Cards lose their borders, titles are no longer in capitals, and the text is easier to read. Notes that only repeated their setting are gone, and the orb and motion preview are plainer.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
